title: Farmhand executor intent v1

task.description: field_work: GIANTS' field-work helper works an owned field with the hitched implement that does the operation; complete only on the field's measured state; target is player_at_acceptance. deliver_tractor_and_forage_wagon: select, hitch and deliver an available pair. move_pair: move the hitched tractor and forage wagon nearest the requester. hitch_pair: select and hitch an available pair where the wagon stands, no delivery. detach_pair: unhitch the implement (of the named kind, else any) from the tractor it is hitched to nearest the requester, where it stands; target is player_at_acceptance. load_tractor: a free tractor (tractor_name) driven up onto a transport trailer's deck (implement_name), belted, ramps raised. unload_tractor: the belted tractor released and backed off the trailer, ramps raised. unload_harvester: an AutoDrive rig with a trailer that has room runs AutoDrive's combine unloader for the combines on field (handed off, kept reserved). sell: the AutoDrive rig with the most cargo (tractor_name if said) delivers it to the best paid sell point; complete when the cargo went and the money came. overload: a standing combine with grain emptied into a tractor's trailer under its pipe (GIANTS GOTO, pipe and discharge); complete when the grain moved.

oneOf.description: move_pair only: back to where this companion took the implement from (the tractor's pose when it hitched it, or found it hitched for field work). No coordinates.

field.description: field_work: an owned field's GIANTS id, or the smallest owned field.

want.description: buy: what to buy. kind: plow (a store plow our tractors can pull), truck, trailer or tractor (by the name the player gave); size large: the widest that fits; engine: the motor configuration with these words in its name.

options.description: Other configuration choices by their words ('25m unrealistic', '25 mph').

tractor_name.description: fetch_pair, hitch_pair: the towing vehicle must have all these words in its name ('with the gmc').

cargo_name.description: move_pair: the rig whose trailer carries this belted vehicle (by its name or brand words).

implement_name.description: fetch_pair, hitch_pair: the implement must have all these words in its name ('the gooseneck').

crop.description: field_work (sow), hitch_pair: the crop to sow in the player's words; a seeder that can sow it, set to it.

hand_off.description: field_work: ends WORKER_STARTED once GIANTS' helper works the field; the pair stays reserved for it (the coordinator watches it end).

over_crop.description: field_work: the player said to work the field even over a standing crop ('... anyway').

area_m2.description: field_work: work only this much of the field (a bounded test area, m2); the whole field when absent.

operation.description: field_work: what to do to the field (companion/field.py OPERATIONS).

implement.description: The implement to hitch or unhitch (a GIANTS specialization kind; default forage_wagon to hitch, any to unhitch). Only for deliver_tractor_and_forage_wagon, hitch_pair, detach_pair, field_work, move_pair (to origin).

description: Move farm equipment to a destination. Every target is travel only; no target starts fieldwork. A place is an AutoDrive marker of exactly that name or the one owned placeable whose name contains its words. Arbitrary coordinates and vehicle IDs are unsupported.
